description.value:
Prerequisite(s): Ability to cast 3rd-level spells, Spell Focus (Illusion)

Benefit: As long as you have an illusion spell of 3rd level or higher in your known spells and have at least 3 MP in your MP pool, you can alter your appearance as the spell disguise self, except that the duration lasts 1 minute per level of the highest-level illusion spell you can cast. This illusory transformation requires a full-round action to activate. As a secondary benefit, you gain a +1 competence bonus to your caster level when casting illusion spells.

system.requirements: Ability to cast 3rd-level spells, Spell Focus (Illusion)
